cards.name: Normal Attack
cards.description: Deal 6 damage to the enemy.
cards.backstory: Simple and direct brute force—perfect for dealing with mindless foes.

cards.name: Heal
cards.description: Restore 6 HP to yourself.
cards.backstory: Just a minor wound—nothing worth worrying about.

cards.name: Defense
cards.description: Gain 6 shield stacks.
cards.backstory: Defense can be a form of attack—after all, battle favors the one who waits for a crack to appear.

cards.name: Shield Counter
cards.description: Gain 3 shield stacks and deal 7 damage to the enemy.
cards.backstory: I took your blow—now it’s your turn!

cards.name: Holy Light
cards.description: Deal 5 damage, restore 2HP
cards.backstory: May this radiance guard you, that you may triumph forever.

cards.name: Intimidate
cards.description: Inflict 1 layer of defense reduction on the enemy for 3 turns.
cards.backstory: Awaken the primal fear within—let instinct drive the coward to flee.

cards.name: Critical Strike
cards.description: Deal 8 damage to the enemy.
cards.backstory: A mighty swing with crushing power—just make sure you can handle the recoil.

cards.name: Trick
cards.description: Remove the enemy's shield and deal damage equal to the shield value removed.
cards.backstory: The difference between us lies here—you've already walked into my trap.

cards.name: Frozen Seal
cards.description: Gain 7 shield, restore 5 HP.
cards.backstory: Wrapped in eternal winter, he has watched generations rise and fall. Time left him untouched, ageless, and unscarred. Staring at the pocket watch in his hand, he wonders what meaning endless life could hold. Perhaps his thoughts and memories have long frozen with the wind—forever sealed in ice.

cards.name: Snow Dance
cards.description:
Inflict 1 stack of Memory effect to enemy for 3 turns.
Memory: Reduce enemy's attack and defense by 1.
cards.backstory: A golden-haired girl dances in the snow, trembling under the biting wind. Yet her movements remain elegant, flowing with the distant melody. From afar, Cheryl watches her—the girl’s grace mirrors someone he once knew. For the first time in ages, his heart stirs again. Clutching his pocket watch, he whispers to himself: this time, he’ll be selfish.

cards.name: Winter Festival
cards.description: Deal 3 damage, restore 4 HP and gain 4 shield.
cards.backstory: In the land of eternal frost, a single day each year brings warmth. The Winter Festival—small but lively—where people shed their coats and dance barefoot on thawed ground. They call it the gods’ blessing, but he knows better. There are no gods here—only borrowed warmth.

cards.name: Iron Blood
cards.description: Gain 5 shield and inflict 1 layer of defense reduction on the enemy for 3 turns.
cards.backstory: He once believed mercy was strength, but the battlefield taught him otherwise. Every drop of blood spilt hardened his resolve. When the world turned its back on justice, he became its blade—cold, unyielding, and drenched in crimson.

cards.name: Candy Bullet
cards.description:
Deal 4 damage. Apply effect Candy to the target.
Candy: When enemy holding this effect, attack enemy will randomly reduce two card's cooldown by 1.
cards.backstory:
"So many candies here."  
"Please, I’m sick of sweets. Haven’t we had enough sugar already?"  
"It’s clean food. Until we find the exit, we can’t afford to be picky."  
"Spare me..."

cards.name: Mist Veil
cards.description:
Apply 3 layers of Mist and 1 layer of Lost to the enemy.
Mist: At the start of enemy's turn, deal 1 damage per Mist stack.
Lost: when taking damage, the target gains Mist equal to the damage taken.
cards.backstory: The accident's smoke spread across the land, choking every corner. The ceaseless machines spewed not smoke, but poison—an ever-expanding cloud that devoured the world.

cards.name: Deep Mist
cards.description:
Apply 6 layers of Mist to the enemy. At the end of your next turn, set the enemy's Mist stacks to 3.
Mist: At the start of enemy's turn, deal 1 damage per Mist stack.
cards.backstory: Wearing a gas mask, he ventured into the factory’s core, where he found the unconscious Dahl. Carrying her back, he followed what he thought was the exit—but the path had changed. Lost in the haze, he realized the mist had swallowed even his memories.

cards.name: Midnight Hour
cards.description:
Apply 'Midnight' to the enemy: Mist damage cannot be blocked by shields, and the same amount of damage is then dealt to the shield.
Mist: At the start of enemy's turn, deal 1 damage per Mist stack.
cards.backstory: At midnight, the mind grows restless. Memories of their near-death escape replay endlessly—but it no longer matters. They survived the mist, and that was enough.

cards.name: Mist Hunt
cards.description:
Deal 1 damage. Reduce the stack of Mist effect on enemy by 1,
then deal damage equals to the stack of Mist effect.
Mist: At the start of enemy's turn, deal 1 damage per Mist stack.
cards.backstory: In the depths of the mist, the hunter becomes the hunted. Every shadow is a potential threat, every sound a warning. But in this game of survival, only the cunning prevail.

cards.name: Mist Blade
cards.description:
Deal 1 damage. Clear all Mist stacks on enemy, then increase this card's additional attack by the number of Mist stacks cleared.
Mist: At the start of enemy's turn, deal 1 damage per Mist stack.
cards.backstory: Forged in the heart of the mist, the blade hums with latent power. Each strike not only wounds the body but also siphons energy from the very essence of the mist itself.

cards.name: Shadow of the Mist
cards.description: When dealing damage to enemy using attack cards, add 1 stack of Midnight effect to enemy, last for 2 rounds.
cards.backstory: In the heart of the mist, shadows dance with malevolent intent. Those who dare to confront it find their own fears reflected back, amplified by the very essence of the mist.

cards.name: Ruined Forge
cards.description:
Inflict 2 stacks of Mist when you use cards other than attack cards.
Mist: At the start of enemy's turn, deal 1 damage per Mist stack.
cards.backstory: Amidst the desolation, the forge stands as a testament to resilience. Though battered and broken, it still radiates a faint warmth, hinting at the potential for rebirth and renewal.

cards.name: Sweet Solace
cards.description: Reduce all the card's maximum cooldown by 1.
cards.backstory: In a world shrouded by mist, moments of clarity are rare and precious. This sweet solace offers a brief respite from the chaos, allowing one to heal and gather strength for the battles ahead.

cards.name: Oath of Resolve
cards.description: When the game starts, increase all cards maximum cooldown by 3. Reduce the damage dealt of this card by the sum of all cards' maximum cooldowns. Deal 60 damage to enemy.
cards.backstory:
After the storm that tore the heavens apart, Radiel lost everything she had.
Grief turned to numbness; her tears had long since dried. With weary steps, she walked eastward—toward a horizon that still shimmered faintly with the illusion of hope.
Her body weary, yet her spirit alight with a fragile flame.
Through countless days and nights, across ruins and silence, she journeyed—
Until at last, she reached the land they had spoken of.

Only a few had made it there; most had perished along the way.
Yet among those few survivors, her gaze froze—
For there, standing before her, was a face both familiar and changed, like a reflection warped by time.
He smiled faintly and said, in a quiet, steady voice:
“Hello. My name is Joshua.”
—And in that moment, the wheels of fate began to turn once again.

cards.name: Redemption
cards.description: End the cooldown of the card that have the highest cooldown. According to the cooldown remain, increase the cooldown of this card for 1 time. Restore mana to full.
cards.backstory: A golden-haired girl dances in the snow, trembling under the biting wind. Yet her movements remain elegant, flowing with the distant melody. From afar, Cheryl watches her—the girl’s grace mirrors someone he once knew. For the first time in ages, his heart stirs again. Clutching his pocket watch, he whispers to himself: this time, he’ll be selfish.
